description: This file defines the ReadableCategory class, which extends CategoryEntity and implements Serializable. It includes properties such as description, parent category, and product count, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ReadableCategory
classes.description: A class representing a readable category with description, parent category, and product count.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the category.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the category.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Returns the number of products in the category.
